title: aid:behavior/* — open content envelope
description: Envelope for the extensible AI-behaviour profile namespace. Any `aid:behavior/<name>/vN` facet MUST use this envelope; `profile` is free-form under the sub-namespace's own schema (registered as an ERC-8419 scheme descriptor when ATTESTED).

profile.description: Suggested core keys for aid:behavior/core/v1: runtime {framework, model, hosting, teeAttested}, skills {categories[], count}, industries[], interaction {protocols[] (A2A, MCP, x402, ...), languages[]}, tasks {categories[], avgCompletionSeconds, acceptanceRate}, autonomyLevel
